sourceBasis: Read current service composition, server route/origin admission, private-query complete batch validation and captured upstream client; verified all eight proposal source bindings against lead runtime.
requirements: Capture and validate an own-data primitive operator digest before any await; reject this option in ordinary prover mode. Preserve default mode semantics when absent.

Require exactly one fixed-length capability header using raw-header duplicate detection, including case variants. Constant-time digest comparison; missing Origin/direct origin does not bypass authentication. Deny before body read, inspector, SDK call or proof-resource creation.

Enforce operator route boundary in the server itself: exact /v1/node only. Health/jobs/compact/admin/proof routes must not become an unauthenticated side path or cause inspector work. CloudFront is not an authentication substitute.

Freeze explicit SDK-derived method names and aliases. Validate the entire batch against schema and operator allowlist before any member executes, including sendTx. No generic dispatcher or silent new SDK methods.
Preserve existing byte/batch/concurrency/timeout limits, one-attempt upstream behavior, credential-free forwarding and owned request drainage. Never log or forward the operator capability.

Retain real HTTP regression cases for missing/wrong/duplicate/malformed/oversized keys, unfinished bodies, direct/missing Origin, valid capability, unsupported mixed batches rejected before first send, default-mode behavior and zero query-only proof resources.

Actual CLI/PXE method and capability coverage is required before external use. Current CLI omits injection on credentials:omit/no-referrer fetches; do not infer compatibility from helper availability alone.
scopeExclusions: No routing, CloudFront, security group, bootstrap/unit/ACL, S3 publication/consumer, account/IAM or remote activation implementation in this first claim
No paid preparation/host launch or real deployment/proof qualification
Future query identity/release ACL compatibility and bounded publication delegation remain separately reviewed changes
semanticNote: This operator endpoint includes transaction submission and simulation; it must not be described as read-only. Unknown send outcomes remain reconcile-only at the operator layer.
